senses.definition: An elongated depression cast between hills or mountains, often with a river flowing through it.
examples: The Indus River valley was the site of an ancient civilization.

senses.definition: An area which drains itself into a river.
Any structure resembling one, e.g. the interior angle formed by the intersection of two sloping roof planes.
(intransitive, poetic, rare) To form the shape of a valley.
